COMMERCIAL & LEGAL

Terms &
Conditions

Commercial guidelines and engineering standards governing quotes, designs, equipment procurement and installation services by Deep Blue Aquatic Systems (Pty) Ltd.

1. Scope of Work

All design engineering, hydraulic calculations, equipment fabrication, procurement, installation, and commissioning supplied by Deep Blue Aquatic Systems (Pty) Ltd are subject to formal technical specifications and agreed commercial contracts.

2. Engineering Proposals & Quotations

Proposals and quotations remain valid for thirty (30) days from issuance, unless otherwise stipulated in writing. Due to biological variability, final system performance depends upon adherence to specified operating stocking densities, feed inputs, water parameters, and maintenance schedules.

3. Intellectual Property

All engineering drawings, hydraulic schematics, CAD designs, automation software configurations, and system models developed by Deep Blue Aquatic Systems remain the proprietary intellectual property of the company until fully paid for and licensed.

4. Equipment Warranty & Support

Equipment supplied (including Faivre drum filters, OxyGuard sensors, Campbell Scientific loggers, and Aqualabo probes) carries original manufacturer warranties, supported by our direct South African technical representation and servicing workshop.

5. Jurisdiction

These terms and all commercial agreements are governed by and construed in accordance with the laws of the Republic of South Africa.

6. Enquiries

For questions regarding contracts, commercial terms, or supply agreements, reach us at info@deepblueaqua.net or telephone +27 21 856 2031.
